notes: Third time this month Kesh has finished off a surrendered enemy. Tonight he didn't even hesitate, and he was smiling after. The others have noticed.
Saoirse used the charm to make the innkeeper's son do her chores, then made him give her his savings. She's been doing it to people for weeks and says it doesn't count because they 'wanted to'.
Grell can't go a night without the black lotus now. He sold his shield for another dose and fought the ghouls half-dazed. Still won, somehow.
Wick sold out the smugglers who'd sheltered us, to the Watch, for 50 gold. He had drinks with them the night before.
Aurel desecrated the shrine of his own god to power the ward that saved the village. He hasn't prayed since. His holy symbol has gone cold.
Nereth made the bargain with the thing in the well: a year of her life for the spell that sealed the rift. She looks older already.
Tovin broke the captured scout's will over three days until he'd say anything. We got the camp location. Nobody at the table enjoyed that scene.
Mara has started taking a trophy from everyone she kills with her bow. She keeps them on a cord. It's up to nine.
Kip robbed the temple's alms box again, the one for plague orphans. Third time. He says he'll pay it back.
Esk raised the dead bandits to carry our gear across the pass. She didn't ask anyone first, and she's done it every day since.
